The static margin is now 13.1% MAC, inside the 5–15% target. T3.mass passes at 1301 g against the 1470 g MTOW, and no T1 check fails.

I added 20 g of ballast to each fin tube (`fin-001-l` and `fin-001-r`, mass 27.1 → 47.1 g). Moving the battery aft made T1 interference and contact checks fail, so I reverted that move.
